newsitem.title: USA: N. Calif. school district nearly insolvent - paper.
newsitem.headline: N. Calif. school district nearly insolvent - paper.

text.p: California's Ready Springs Union School District is on the verge of insolvency and could be taken over by the state, according to a published report on Thursday.

The Sacramento Bee reported that the Nevada County district shows a budget year ending balance for June 30 of only $16,500, far short of the $138,000 mandated by the state. Earlier this week, the district's superintendent, Larry Babcock, resigned the post effective June 30.

Terry McAteer, Nevada County's superintendent of schools, told the Bee that he has asked a state financial crisis team to take over the drafting of a balanced district budget, and he warned that the district's financial condition could prompt a state takeover.
